name: Wanderwine
description: The river that the group travels, now cut by a line of night.

description_citations.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
description_citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Abigale flies Sanar, Kirol and Tam across the Wanderwine one at a time.
timeline.quote: They spread their arms, and Abigale grasped them, taking to the air.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Abigale stumbles into the tributary and is swept toward the Wanderwine.
timeline.quote: As she stumbled, her foot hit the top of the sloping bank that led down to the water, and she fell.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Fish-people armed with spears surround Abigale; their leader signs to her and invites her to come see something.
timeline.quote: We have something you must see

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The merrow tow Abigale into the depths of the Wanderwine.
timeline.quote: they began to swim toward the Wanderwine proper, towing Abigale along with them.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen explains she keeps Rhys alive by magic through their binding promise.
timeline.quote: As long as he's bound to me, my magic keeps him alive.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen, Tam, Sanar and Ashling set out down the Wanderwine in a boggart-crewed boat, and Maralen tells of Oona's great aurora.
timeline.quote: she managed to capture the auroras that naturally flare between night and day and braid them into a single great aurora

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen reveals she was made by Oona as a weapon-avatar and slipped into the skin of Maralen of the Mornsong.
timeline.quote: I was to be her avatar, a part of her, carrying her consciousness ahead of my own.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen tells of her older brother, Oona's first avatar, who defied her, befriended a giant he called father, and vanished after Oona had the giant killed.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Shadowmoor claims the Wanderwine and the boggarts refuse to go farther, forcing the group to walk.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.
